recipes.name: Classic Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: A fragrant Italian staple highlighting garlic, chili, and fresh parsley gently emulsified with pasta water and olive oil.

ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp for boiling water, plus a pinch to taste

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season generously with salt from the canister.
Add pasta from the box and cook until al dente, reserving 1/2 cup of the starchy cooking water before draining.
While pasta is cooking, heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-low heat.
Add thinly sliced garlic and chili flakes, cooking gently for 2 to 3 minutes until the garlic is golden and aromatic without burning.
Transfer drained pasta directly into the skillet along with 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water.
Toss vigorously over medium heat until a glossy sauce coats the strands.
Remove from heat, fold in the chopped parsley and black pepper, and serve topped with grated parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Crispy Garlic and Herb Cheese Toast
recipes.description: A comforting, golden stovetop melt topped with savory melted cheese and aromatic garlic butter. We assume the block of cheese is a firm melting cheese such as cheddar or gouda.
steps: In a small bowl, mix softened butter with minced garlic, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Spread the garlic herb butter evenly over one side of each bread slice.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Place the bread slices butter-side down into the hot skillet.
Distribute the grated cheese evenly over the tops of the slices.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the bottom is toasted and the cheese is fully melted.
Remove lid, fold slices together to make sandwiches (or serve open-faced), slice diagonally, and enjoy hot.

recipes.name: Caramelized Snack Bar Skillet Crumble
recipes.description: A sweet, warm breakfast or dessert skillet made with caramelized bread bites and crunchy crumble. We assume the snack bar is an oat and honey grain bar.
steps: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the bread cubes and toast, tossing frequently, until lightly browned on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Push bread cubes to one side of the skillet and melt the remaining tablespoon of butter on the other side.
Add the sugar, pinch of salt, and the crushed snack bar into the melted butter, stirring for 1 to 2 minutes until bubbly and caramelized.
Toss the toasted bread cubes thoroughly in the sweet crumble mixture to coat evenly.
Transfer to a bowl and let cool for 2 minutes to allow the topping to crisp up before serving.
